explanation: His rebels toppled the dictator Fulgencio Batista. The campaign had begun in 1956, when Castro sailed from Mexico with 82 men crammed aboard a small yacht, the Granma.

claims.text: Fidel Castro led the revolutionary forces that took power in Cuba in January 1959.

In December 1956 Castro landed in Cuba from Mexico aboard the yacht Granma.
